conservative_listener_prerequisite: UI port9821 must be unused before stage and activation. Retained implementation0014 preinstall baseline already had stock127.0.0.1:81 plus original wildcard proxy80; neither is incorrectly required absent before the approved replacement restart. Never identify or kill socket owners. After that one Xochitl restart, require port80 absent and port81 present only on127.0.0.1. Refuse otherwise and preserve partial state; no extra restart or retry.
unit_identity_rules: Unit must be not-found and fixed persistent/transient paths unused before stage/activation
Only systemd-run creates pi-ink-0054.service; Restart=no, no enable, no unit files
Restore requires Transient=yes, exact Description and same nonempty InvocationID recorded after creation
An exited/collected/mismatched unit or incomplete activation is an explicit manual-review blocker; no legacy detection or retry
pdf_policy: Repeat --pdf-sha256 for each actual pending synthetic PDF. Runtime allowlist must match exactly, in order; no precomputed or completed-request digest.

setupInputsRequired: New private desktop TLS certificate/key, stable content server ID, verified HTTPS origin and explicitly selected synthetic device ID. These are not bootstrap discovery IDs.
Provision that certificate/CA identity, HTTPS origin, server ID and device ID to mode-0600 runtime config; no initial content token.
Generate independent desktop-only managementToken; never copy it into tablet configuration or public bootstrap assets.
Approve exact synthetic source PDF SHA256 allowlist and new private absolute association-state path. No old credential/config reading is authorized.
approvalBoundary: This payload does not authorize any device connection or mutation. Parent must obtain separate scope for cable-connected installation/repair, synthetic document operations, stock/XOVI activation, each saved/closed Xochitl restart, listener checks and rollback.

Resolve unknown state and the conflicting webserver-remote extension through a new operator-approved procedure. Do not diagnose or retry cleanup0038. Stop on occupied/colliding paths, mismatched hashes or unsupported firmware.
Preserve existing binary/version as rollback inputs before a separately approved update of the one existing pi-ink-client installation. Do not install a second runtime binary or shim.
Provision trust through trusted setup, then pair from the native manager and explicitly approve the matching device/approval ID on loopback desktop management HTTPS.
After USB disconnection, use only pinned HTTPS/WSS for source, status and results. No runtime SSH/USB or public job API.

Owner must verify root folder creation/visibility, import destination, native current-document/foldout behavior, explicit Send/clipping confirmation/PNG, Save/Close and wrong-document/server/request isolation, pen/palm/undo/erase/zoom/orientation quality, retained editable work and lifecycle limits.
Rollback must restore only exact recorded owned paths/configurations under explicit scope. No generic cleanup, no blind helper execution, no inferred restoration success.
limitations: Host smoke uses simulated stock HTTP/native events/browser launch/test-process exit. No tablet app pairing, library visibility, pen quality or cable-free integrated Send is claimed.
Native createCollection empty root-parent argument still requires device validation. Imports remain at their observed stock destination, not automatically in the created associated folder.
Self-update remains unsigned-development behavior; adjacent HTTP checksum is not publisher trust. The owner must approve this out-of-band exact payload hash.
